item.title: Introduction
item.description: Raspberry Pi Sentry Droplet WireGuard VPN d.rymcg.tech The dual roles of the Raspberry Pi Your personal workstation Next steps Raspberry Pi Here is my Raspberry Pi 5, which is a small form factor Linux computer, running Raspberry Pi OS and Docker. It has been outfitted with an NVME SSD attached via the expandable PCI-E bus. It has 8GB of RAM and 1TB of fast storage. I use this as a tiny web server that I can take anywhere I go.
